rows.text:
Subject: Refund request

Hello, I purchased Yakeen NEET 2.0 last week but I have decided to join an offline coaching instead. Please refund my fees of Rs 4,500.

Regards,
Sneha
reasons: Needs account/payment action: Refund request requires checking purchase and processing the refund.
rows.reply: Hi Sneha, thanks for letting us know about your plans. Online batches like Yakeen NEET 2.0 are non-refundable once bought, and this applies whatever the reason, including stopping or switching studies [RF-1]. The exceptions are a batch bought by mistake, payment errors, and damaged or lost book orders [RF-1]. If you bought the batch by mistake, you can ask to change it to another batch of the same amount within 10 days of purchase; just share your order ID, the batch you bought and the batch you want [RF-2]. Every refund or batch-change request is reviewed by a support agent, who will check your order against the policy and reply with a decision [RF-4]. PW aims to resolve support queries within 7 days [RF-4].

classification.needs_human_reason: Refund request requires checking purchase and processing the refund.
